name: interview
description: Interviews and group conversations with short turns and colloquial speech.
whisper_instruction: This is an interview or group conversation. Preserve names, natural wording, short responses, and Chinese-English code-switching.
refine_instruction: Treat the recording as an interview. Preserve turn-taking, questions, short answers, hesitation that carries meaning, and the speaker's level of certainty. Do not invent speaker names or merge distinct turns.
